svg.title: Security homelab network diagram
svg.desc: OPNsense firewall with a NAT WAN and three zones: Attacker with Kali, Internal with ubuntu-srv and a Wazuh server, and DMZ with an nginx web server. One dashed path shows the only allowed Attacker to Internal traffic; Attacker to DMZ is broadly allowed.
svg.text: Solid: Attacker→DMZ (broadly allowed). Wazuh unreachable from Attacker.
